name: RV-42N (RV-N cycloidal reducer)
notes: Nabtesco RV (Rotate Vector) two-stage cycloidal precision reducer - the gear used in the shoulder/elbow/base joints of most industrial robots (Nabtesco holds a large share of that market). This is a GEARBOX, not an integrated actuator: no motor, driver, encoder or voltage of its own (paired with a customer servomotor), hence those fields are null and integrated_driver false. RV-42N: 412 N.m rated output torque, momentary maximum (emergency-stop) torque 5x rated (~2060 N.m), available ratios up to ~185:1 (141:1 shown), <1 arcmin backlash, mass 6.3 kg, OD 159mm. Torque density is computed from momentary max torque over mass. Quote-only pricing.

name: M107 Joint Motor
notes: High-torque internal-rotor PMSM joint used across the Unitree H1 humanoid; the same M107 unit is deployed at different gear stages for different joints - Unitree quotes 360 N.m (knee), 220 N.m (hip), 75 N.m (arm), 45 N.m (ankle). Peak torque here uses the 360 N.m knee figure. 107x74mm, hollow shaft for cable routing, industrial crossed-roller output bearing. Manufacturer states 189 N.m/kg torque density; weight_g (~1.9 kg) is INFERRED from 360 N.m / 189 (N.m/kg) and is not a directly published value, so verified is false. Gear ratio, voltage, comm bus and price are not published for the bare motor (sold as part of H1); left null.

name: RMD-X8-120
notes: High-torque, large-hollow-bore planetary joint for arm base/humanoid joints. RMD-X8-P20-120: 120 N.m peak, 43 N.m rated, 127 rpm rated speed, 574 W, 1.40 kg per OpenELAB/RobotShop. Actual reduction ~19.6:1 (nominal 20:1). One reseller lists 110 N.m peak. EtherCAT and CAN driver variants.

name: RobStride 04
notes: Largest mainstream RobStride QDD module. 120 N.m peak, 40 N.m rated, 9:1 reduction, size 110x50 mm, 15-60 V driver working voltage, CAN, dual magnetic encoders. Installed mass 1420 g (1.4 kg) per RobStride/Seeed/OpenELAB. Priced at $255 on Seeed Studio (authorized RobStride distributor, USD). No-load speed 200 rpm +/-10% at 48 V per RobStride RS04 user manual 260713.

name: GIM6010-36 (48V)
notes: Steel two-stage 36:1 planetary joint module with a published ~15 arcmin gearbox backlash (important for arms). 48 V config: 221 W, 18 N.m rated, 41 N.m stall, 12-56 V range. Weight 574 g with driver (546 g without) per Steadywin/OpenELAB. Output speed 50-97 rpm depending on driver.

name: RobStride 03
notes: Mid-size QDD module for larger arms/legs. 60 N.m peak, 20 N.m rated at 100 rpm, 9:1 reduction, 48 V nominal (15-60 V driver range), dual magnetic encoders. Rated 20 N.m (tested at 100 rpm) and mass 880 g +/-20 g per RobStride RS03 user manual 260713 (Seeed/OpenELAB list 21 N.m and 900 g). Priced at $249.99 on Seeed Studio (authorized RobStride distributor, USD).

name: STS3250 (12V, 50 kg.cm)
notes: Heavy-duty all-metal, coreless-motor, dual-shaft bus servo. Stall torque 50 kg.cm = 4.9 N.m and speed 0.133 s/60 deg (~75 rpm) quoted at 12V. Same TTL protocol/form factor as the STS3215; used in beefier open-source arms and legs.

name: XM540-W270-T
notes: Coreless-motor sibling of the XH540 in the same frame, tuned for higher torque and lower speed. Stall torque 10.6 N.m and no-load 30 rpm quoted at 12.0V. Full 6-mode control. -T is TTL; -R is RS-485.

name: XH540-W270-T
notes: High-torque metal-gear X servo. Stall torque 9.9 N.m @12.0V (rises to ~10.6 N.m @14.8V); no-load 39 rpm @12V. Rated backlash 15 arcmin. Used in larger research arms and quadruped legs. -T is TTL; -R is RS-485.

name: GIM8108-8
notes: MIT-Cheetah-style QDD clone with very high torque density. 22 Nm stall / 7.5 Nm rated, 8:1 steel planetary (~15 arcmin backlash), nominal 110 rpm / max 320 rpm after reduction, 336W, 48V nominal (24-56V). SDC-series driver with CAN and USB-C config. Weight 375 g (net; ~0.8 kg gross shipping). Price roughly $55-112/unit wholesale (Alibaba, MOQ 2); no confirmed retail USD, so null.

name: AK10-9 (V3.0 KV60)
notes: Largest AK-series QDD, for big-dog legs and heavy arms. V3.0 KV60: 53 Nm peak / 18 Nm rated, no-load 320 rpm / rated 235 rpm at 48V (max_speed_rpm is the rated figure). Earlier V2.0 KV60 rated 48 Nm peak / 18 Nm. Net weight 960 g (V2.0 confirmed at 0.96 kg; V3.0 is the same motor and gearbox with only an updated driver board, so weight is unchanged). Pricing varies widely by retailer/version (RobotShop lists V3.0 KV60 ~$1,140; historical V2 street ~$400-500) so price_usd left null.

name: STS3215 (12V, 30 kg.cm)
notes: The default actuator of the LeRobot SO-ARM100/SO-101 arms. Stall torque 30 kg.cm = 2.94 N.m and no-load 45 rpm (0.222 s/60 deg) quoted at 12V; a common 7.4V variant gives ~19.5 kg.cm = 1.91 N.m. Ships in multiple gear-ratio SKUs (1:147 C046, 1:191 C044, 1:345 C001/C018). Half-duplex TTL serial bus, position + wheel (velocity) modes.

name: H54-200-S500-R (Dynamixel PRO)
notes: Original Dynamixel PRO H-series (predecessor to the Pro+ PH54), a 200W RS-485 joint used in full-size humanoids/large arms. Stall torque 44.7 N.m and no-load 33.1 rpm at 24V (continuous torque ~25.3 N.m); weight 855 g; ~502:1 straight-type reduction. Officially discontinued by Robotis and now sold only on the secondary market, so no current list price. Superseded by the Pro+ PH54-200-S500-R, whose rated torque coincidentally also lists 44.7 N.m.

name: XM430-W350-T
notes: Metal-gear, coreless-motor workhorse. Stall torque 4.1 N.m and no-load 46 rpm quoted at 12.0V. Full 6-mode control including current (torque). Backbone of Trossen ViperX/WidowX and ALOHA/OpenManipulator-X arms. -T is TTL; -R variant is RS-485.

name: AK70-10 (KV100)
notes: High torque-density QDD widely used in DIY quadrupeds and jumping-leg research. 24.8 Nm peak / 8.3 Nm rated. max_speed_rpm is manufacturer rated speed at 48V (148 rpm at 24V). Price ~$399 (CubeMars store $398.90). [Verified Sep 2026: net weight 521 g (was listed 610 g), backlash 8 arcmin per CubeMars/MAB Robotics.]

name: AK80-9 (V3.0 KV100)
notes: The canonical MIT-Cheetah-style QDD module. V3.0 KV100 rates 22 Nm peak / 9 Nm continuous (earlier V1/V2 were 18 Nm peak). No-load 570 rpm, rated 390 rpm at 48V. Supports CubeMars 'servo' and 'MIT' hybrid modes; needs an external CAN adapter. Price ~$580 street (RobotShop sale $579.90, list $599.90).

name: RobStride 00
notes: Smallest RobStride QDD integrated module. 14 N.m peak, 10:1 reduction, ~170 W, 24-60 V, dual 14-bit encoders, CAN, MIT-mode control. Weight 310 g per RobStride/Seeed/OpenELAB. Priced at $125 on Seeed Studio (authorized RobStride distributor, USD). Rated 5 N.m (tested at 100 rpm, 48 V) and no-load speed 315 rpm +/-10% per RobStride RS00 user manual 260713.

name: RobStride 01
notes: Compact 36 V-nominal QDD module (24-48 V range). 17 N.m peak, 6 N.m rated at 100 rpm, 7.75:1 reduction, single magnetic encoder, 380 g per Seeed/OpenELAB. Rated 6 N.m (tested at 100 rpm) per RobStride RS01 user manual 260713; earlier reseller listings quoted 7 N.m. Priced at $143.99 on Seeed Studio (authorized RobStride distributor, USD). No-load speed 315 rpm +/-10% at 36 V per RobStride RS01 user manual 260713.

name: GO-M8010-6
notes: Joint motor from the Unitree Go1 quadruped. Manual gives 23.7 Nm max output torque, 30 rad/s (~286 rpm) max speed, torque constant 0.63895 Nm/A (at output), max current 40A, 6.33:1 reduction, built-in FOC. Continuous/rated torque not published (comparison sources cite ~9-10 Nm). Weight ~530 g per manual (some resellers list 420-440 g). Voltage 24V recommended (manual cites 12-30V; some listings up to 48V). Uses Unitree's RS-485/serial bus, not CAN. Price ~$369 (Unitree shop).

name: DM-J8009-2EC
notes: 98mm OD x 61.7mm integrated joint motor, MIT driver + dual magnetic encoders, CAN bus at 1 Mbps with telemetry (speed/position/torque/temperature). 20 N.m rated, 40 N.m peak, ~100 rpm rated output, 9:1, 24V. Supports MIT, speed and position modes. User manual lists ~896g. DM-J8009P-2EC variant uses a crossed-roller output bearing instead of the deep-groove bearing. Priced at $385 on Foxtech (authorized DAMIAO distributor, USD). Maximum no-load speed 160 rpm at the 24 V rated voltage (320 rpm at 48 V) per DAMIAO user manual V1.1 specifications table.

name: SCA QDD-Lite-NE30-36
notes: Smart Compliant Actuator used in the INNFOS Gluon desktop cobot arm; integrates reducer + outer-rotor motor + precision encoder + collision detection + driver. QDD-Lite-NE30-36: 2.3 N.m rated / 10 N.m peak, ~30 rpm rated output, 52mm dia x 68.8mm, ~232g. Despite the -36 designation the actual reduction ratio is 33.6:1. Regulates position/velocity/torque/impedance directly. Smallest/lightest premium joint here (cobot-scale, not heavy-arm). The Gluon arm runs on a 42V supply; per-actuator rated voltage is not separately confirmed so voltage is null. INNFOS branding is largely defunct (project continued under Mintasca) so availability is unknown.

name: ST3215 Serial Bus Servo (30 kg.cm)
notes: Waveshare-branded Feetech STS3215-class magnetic-encoder bus servo, servo/motor mode switchable. Torque 30 kg.cm = 2.94 N.m @12V (19.5 kg.cm = 1.91 N.m @7.4V variant); no-load 45 rpm (0.222 s/60 deg) @12V; locked-rotor 2.7A. The Waveshare-branded unit is listed at ~68 to 69 g (heavier than the 55 g Feetech OEM). A faster ST3215-HS variant trades to ~20 kg.cm / 106 rpm. Used in Waveshare RoArm kits and LeRobot builds.

name: RobStride 02
notes: Dual-encoder sibling of RobStride 01. 17 N.m peak, 6 N.m rated, 7.75:1 reduction, 48 V nominal (24-60 V range), ~170 W, torque constant 1.22 N.m/A, dual 14-bit magnetic encoders, CAN with MIT-mode control. Weight 380 g +/-3 g per RobStride RS02 user manual 260713 (Seeed/OpenELAB list 405 g). Priced at $160.99 on Seeed Studio (authorized RobStride distributor, USD). No-load speed 410 rpm +/-10% at 48 V per RobStride RS02 user manual 260713.

name: LPA-20 (Low Profile Rotary Actuator)
notes: Low-profile integrated servo actuator aimed at humanoid/cobot joints and surgical robotics. Combines zero-backlash Harmonic Drive gearing, a brushless servomotor, brake, dual absolute encoders and an integrated servo drive (CANopen/EtherCAT). Gear ratios 51/81/101:1. Continuous torque 6.5 to 16.9 N·m and maximum (peak) torque 34 to 57 N·m depending on ratio; recorded values are the top-of-range (101:1) figures. Weight about 1.4 kg. Rated supply voltage 48 VDC (confirmed via distributor listing). torque_density computed from peak 57 N·m over 1.4 kg. Repeatability not published in accessible sources, so left null. Quote-only pricing.

name: CyberGear Micromotor
notes: Xiaomi's low-cost MIT-Cheetah-style micromotor (from the CyberDog / CyberOne ecosystem), popular for hobby legs and arms. 12 Nm peak / 4 Nm continuous, 7.75:1 reduction, 24V, max 296 rpm, 14-bit encoder, CAN (1 Mbps) plus serial, integrated FOC driver with position/velocity/torque/impedance (MIT) modes. Manufacturer-stated torque density 37.85 Nm/kg. Listed EOL by some distributors; street price historically ~$80-120, so price_usd left null.

name: LX-16A
notes: Full-metal-gear serial bus servo popular in SpotMicro-class hobby quadrupeds and the Hiwonder xArm. Stall torque 17 kg.cm (1.67 N.m) @6V and 19.5 kg.cm (1.91 N.m) @7.4V; speed 0.19 s/60 deg (~53 rpm) @7.4V; 240 deg range; stall current 2.4-3A; position accuracy 0.3 deg; weight 52 g. Uses a private half-duplex TTL protocol (needs Hiwonder debug board). Price approximate.

name: RMD-X8 Pro V2 (1:9)
notes: Popular arm/leg joint module. Peak 25 N.m and rated 13 N.m per RobotShop/MyActuator; nominal ~122 rpm, ~160 rpm no-load at 48 V. Net weight 710 g per manufacturer/factory listings. Priced at $557.24 on RobotShop (USD).

name: qdd100 beta 3
notes: Open-source QDD servo built on the moteus controller (CAN-FD, 5 Mbps). Thermal-limited torque at 24V: 16 Nm peak (<1s), 10 Nm for 60s, 6 Nm for 400s, 3.3 Nm indefinitely (rated_torque_nm uses the indefinite figure). Peak speed 2300 dps (~383 rpm) at 24V, 3600 dps at 36V; backlash +/-0.25 deg (~15 arcmin), input 10-44V. Net weight 507 g per the beta 3 product page (the original beta was 470 g). The mjbots product page lists a regular price of $879 (currently out of stock, MOQ 50); price_per_nm uses the 16 N.m peak torque, matching the dataset convention. Marked beta by the vendor.

name: SCS15
notes: Older Feetech SCS-series bus servo using a potentiometer (not a magnetic encoder), ~200 deg servo range. Stall torque quoted across voltages: 15 kg.cm (1.47 N.m) @6V, 16.5 kg.cm @7.4V, 17 kg.cm (1.67 N.m) @8.4V; speed up to 73 rpm @8.4V. Half-duplex TTL multi-drop bus.

name: XL330-M288-T
notes: Tiny 5V smart servo with engineering-plastic gears. Stall torque 0.52 N.m and no-load 103 rpm quoted at 5.0V (falls to ~0.38 N.m / ~76 rpm at 3.7V). Widely used as the actuator for LeRobot Koch leader/follower arms and small hobby quadrupeds. Protocol 2.0.

name: GIM6010-8
notes: Compact 80 mm QDD joint, MIT-Cheetah-style. 11 Nm stall / 5 Nm rated, 8:1 steel planetary (~15 arcmin), nominal 120 rpm / max 420 rpm, 252W, 24V nominal (12-56V), continuous current 10.5A. SDC104 driver (CAN + USB-C). Weight ~388 g net. Often compared with Xiaomi CyberGear. Wholesale ~$50-100/unit (Alibaba, MOQ 2); no confirmed retail USD, so null.

name: XL430-W250-T
notes: Entry-level engineering-plastic-gear X servo. Stall torque quoted at multiple voltages: 1.0 N.m @9.0V, 1.4 N.m @11.1V, 1.5 N.m @12.0V; no-load 61 rpm @12V. No current-control mode (no current sensing). Used in TurtleBot3, OpenManipulator and hobby arms. Street price varies (~$27-50).

name: AK80-6 (KV100)
notes: Faster, lower-torque sibling of the AK80-9 (6:1 vs 9:1) used in exoskeletons and light legs. 600 rpm rated speed. max_speed_rpm listed is the manufacturer rated speed at 48V (no-load higher). Price ~$470 (CubeMars store $469.90).

name: XC430-W150-T
notes: Metal-gear version of the XL430 frame; lower gear ratio gives higher speed (106 rpm no-load @12V) with stall torque 1.6 N.m @12V. No current-control mode. Price (~$138 on robotis.us) is hard to verify and varies widely by region/reseller.

name: SC15 Serial Bus Servo (17 kg.cm)
notes: Lower-cost Waveshare/Feetech bus servo with potentiometer feedback (180 deg servo / 360 deg motor mode). Stall torque 14 kg.cm @4.8V, 15 kg.cm @6V, 17 kg.cm (1.67 N.m) @8.4V; no-load ~62 rpm (0.16 s/60 deg) @6V; stall current 1.7A. Price left null - retail listings ranged widely (~$15-22) and could not be reliably confirmed.

name: AK60-6 (V3.0 KV80)
notes: Smallest AK-series QDD; 9 Nm peak / 3 Nm rated, 380 g (V3.0). max_speed_rpm is rated speed at 48V (233 rpm at 24V). Older V1.1 KV140 variant is 368 g and rated to ~420 rpm. Price ~$427 (RobotShop, V3.0 KV80).

name: FHA-14C-100 (FHA-C Mini)
encoder: dual absolute (15-bit motor input, 14-bit output), battery-less within one turn
notes: Compact hollow-shaft AC servo actuator: pancake BLDC motor plus zero-backlash Harmonic Drive strain-wave gear. FHA-C Mini family sizes 8C/11C/14C with ratios 30/50/100:1. For FHA-14C at 100:1 the maximum (peak/momentary) torque is 28 N·m and continuous/rated torque is about 6.8 N·m; maximum output speed 60 rpm. 'Zero backlash' is the manufacturer strain-wave claim (recorded as 0). Positioning accuracy about 90 arc-sec (1.5 arcmin); repeatability not published in accessible sources, so left null. 24VDC integrated-drive version communicates via CANopen (4-wire) with an EtherCAT option. Weight about 1.65 kg per Radwell distributor listing for the exact FHA-14C-100-D200-M1-SP part. Quote-only pricing.

name: RMD-X6-8 V3
notes: Entry-level planetary joint module (MC-X-300 driver built in). Peak torque 8 N.m and rated 4.5 N.m at 310 rpm per RobotShop V3 1:8 listing. Net weight 490 g per the MyActuator X6-8 spec sheet and Amazon listing.

name: RI60 KV120
encoder: Optional Hall-sensor version; bare frameless kit (add own encoder)
notes: Motor. Frameless inrunner torque motor kit, dia 60 x 23 mm. Peak torque 1.63 Nm at 16.8A peak; rated torque 0.57 Nm; rated current 5.6A; 85 W. Phase resistance 900 mOhm, inductance 877.5 uH, 14 pole pairs. max_speed is no-load computed from KV120 x 48V (not a published datasheet figure; rated speed at 48V is ~3190 rpm). Kt not published. Needs external FOC driver.

name: RI80 V2.0 KV75
encoder: Optional Hall-sensor version; bare frameless kit (add own encoder)
notes: Motor. Frameless inrunner torque motor, dia 85 x 82 mm, delta winding, 8 pole pairs. Peak torque 4.1 Nm; rated torque 1.45 Nm; rated current 9.4A. max_speed_rpm is the rated speed at 48V. Kt not published. Needs external FOC driver.

name: R60 KV115
encoder: Integrated Hall sensors (14 pole pairs); Ke 0.0087 V/rpm
notes: Motor. R-series torque motor (housed/framed with bearings + Hall sensors), dia 73.8 x 23 mm. Peak torque 2.3 Nm at 28A peak; rated torque 0.75 Nm at ~8.5A; no-load speed ~5520 rpm; 351 W. The bare-frameless equivalents are the RO60 outrunner and RI60 inrunner. Needs an external FOC driver (e.g. ODrive/moteus). Km 0.171 Nm/sqrt(W).

name: RMD-L-9015-16T
notes: RMD-L is a direct-drive (gearless) outer-rotor gimbal-style actuator with integrated driver/encoder, not a geared joint reducer. Low torque, high speed, fully backdrivable; better suited to gimbals/light QDD than high-load arm joints. Nominal 1.64 N.m, max instantaneous 3.4 N.m, 780 rpm, 200 W, 24 V, 650 g per Amazon listing and MyActuator L-series manual.

name: iPower GM8112-80T
notes: Motor. Large gimbal/direct-drive motor, 36N/42P, dia 89.5 x 33.4 mm, hollow shaft, weight 428g. Torque figures converted from published load torque (manufacturer quotes 6 kg-cm = 0.59 Nm; higher listings cite up to 9 kg-cm = 0.88 Nm); no-load current 0.3A, load current 2A, phase resistance 4.2 ohm. Low-Kv (80T) gimbal winding suited to low-speed direct-drive joints. Price is with-encoder variant (iFlight EU). Needs external FOC/gimbal driver.

name: DM-J10010-2EC
notes: MIT-driven integrated joint motor with built-in gearbox and dual encoders; supports MIT (impedance/torque), position and velocity modes. 100mm-class body, ~100 rpm class output, 10:1 reduction. Resellers agree on 40 N.m rated / 150 N.m peak at 48V. Left unverified pending an English manufacturer datasheet. Priced at $357 on Foxtech (authorized DAMIAO distributor, USD). Maximum no-load speed 150 rpm (rated 100 rpm) at 48 V and motor weight about 1485 g per DAMIAO DM-J10010-2EC manual V1.0 specifications table.

name: GIM8115-36
notes: 8115-frame BLDC (mini-Cheetah style) with 36:1 planetary reducer and built-in driver; 54 N.m high-ratio variant of the GIM8115 family (also sold as -6/-9). ~30 rpm output, 160W, 36-48V. kt 0.28 N.m/A is the MOTOR-side torque constant (before the gearbox). Rated (continuous) output torque is not separately published (54 N.m is the stall/peak figure). Only a gross shipping weight (~1.2 kg incl. packaging) is listed by resellers, not a net actuator mass, so weight_g and torque_density are left null and verified is false. 36:1 ratio makes it largely non-backdrivable.

name: DriveSpin DS110 (TwinSpin cycloidal)
notes: True zero-backlash cycloidal (TwinSpin) rotary actuator: an AC servomotor coupled to a TwinSpin two-disc cycloidal reduction gear with an integrated high radial/axial-load output bearing. Spinea's DS110 page lists rated output torque 122 N.m, acceleration/braking (peak) output torque 244 N.m, available reduction ratios 67/89/119:1, and rated input speed 2000 rpm; output speed and mass vary by servomotor and configuration so max_speed_rpm and weight_g are left null. Lost motion (backlash) <=1 arcmin, repeatable positioning accuracy <10 arcsec (~0.17 arcmin). Requires an external servo drive (integrated_driver false). Industrial/quote pricing. Not backdrivable.

name: Arc Series Cycloidal Joint Actuator
notes: Integrated cycloidal joint module line aimed at humanoids/heavy arms: self-developed cycloidal reducer + BLDC motor + driver + dual encoders in one unit. Series-level specs: rated torque range 3-150 N.m across sizes, max torque up to 530 N.m (used as peak here), 24-72V, rated speed 80-100 rpm, backlash and repeatability ~1 arcmin, withstands >5x rated momentary overload, CAN-FD + EtherCAT. Per-model rated torque, weight and gear ratio are not published individually (this entry represents the series envelope) so those are null and verified is false. Low backdrivability by design. Quote/OEM pricing.

name: EC frameless 90 flat (260 W)
encoder: None (frameless rotor/stator kit; add own sensor)
notes: Motor. Part 542099, dia 90 mm flat frameless BLDC kit (rotor + stator supplied separately, no bearings/shaft). The maxon product page lists nominal (max continuous) torque 989 mNm (~1 N.m), stall torque 9.76 N.m, weight 814 g, and max speed 5000 rpm; torque constant 136 mNm/A, 11 pole pairs. Suited to gearless direct drive. maxon lists this part as NRND (not recommended for new designs); listed at EUR pricing only so price_usd left null.

name: TQ-RoboDrive ILM85x26
encoder: None (frameless stator/rotor kit; add own sensor)
notes: Motor. Frameless hollow-shaft servo kit, dia 85 x 26 mm. TQ-RoboDrive ILM datasheet gives rated torque 2.9 N.m, peak torque 9.37 N.m (at 20% deviation from linearity), and kit weight 670 g for the ILM85x26. Kt 73 mNm/A at 20C, Km 0.52 Nm/sqrt(W), rated current 39.8A (delta-parallel), terminal resistance 27 mOhm, inductance 87 uH, no-load speed 5400 rpm. High-end frameless kit for cobot/humanoid joints; needs external FOC driver.

name: Megaflux MF0127 (frameless)
encoder: None (frameless rotor/stator kit; add own sensor)
notes: Motor. Frameless direct-drive brushless torque motor, 127 mm frame diameter (part of the Megaflux MF family, 60 to 330 mm frames, multiple stack lengths each). Per-winding specs (Kt, continuous stall / peak torque, weight) not captured: manufacturer datasheet PDF fetch was blocked by network policy. Family continuous stall torque spans ~0.3 Nm up to ~2020 Nm across all frames. Cite the linked MF0127 datasheet for exact values.

name: ODrive v3.6
notes: Driver/controller (not a motor, so no torque/weight rating). Dual-axis FOC BLDC controller. Sold in 24V (12-24V) and 56V (12-56V) variants; 120A peak per motor. Classic CAN (not CAN-FD). Now marked NRND (not recommended for new designs); ODrive steers new builds to the S1. Listed at $259 on the official ODrive store (56V variant).

name: ODrive S1
encoder: Onboard MA702 magnetic encoder; supports SPI/Hall/quadrature/RS485 offboard
notes: Driver/controller (not a motor, so no torque/weight rating). Single-axis FOC BLDC controller. 12-48V nominal (50.5V abs max), 40A continuous with heat spreader, 120A peak (voltage-derated). ~2kW continuous. CAN 2.0B @1Mbps plus experimental CAN-FD @5Mbps; also STEP/DIR, PWM, analog. Trajectory + feed-forward control. Common choice for DIY QDD actuators.

name: ODrive Pro
encoder: Onboard MA702 magnetic encoder; supports offboard SPI/Hall/quadrature
notes: Driver/controller (not a motor, so no torque/weight rating). Single-axis FOC BLDC controller, 12-56V (58V abs max), 70A continuous (with heatsink+fan), 120A peak, ~5kW peak power. Semi-isolated or fully isolated CAN-FD transceiver. Higher-current sibling of the S1; regenerative braking. Volume pricing to ~$209 at 100 units.

name: moteus r4.11
notes: Driver/controller (not a motor; weight_g is the board mass, 14.2g). Compact single-axis FOC controller designed for QDD/legged robots. 10-44V (up to 10S), 100A peak phase current, 12A uncooled / 32A cooled continuous, ~900W peak @30V. 5Mbps CAN-FD native. Board $94; developer kit ~$219. Widely used in low-cost QDD actuator builds.

name: moteus c1
notes: Driver/controller (not a motor; weight_g is the board mass, 8.9g). Smaller/lower-power single-axis FOC controller. 10-51V (up to 12S), 20A peak phase current, 5A uncooled / 14A cooled continuous, ~250W peak @28V. 5Mbps CAN-FD. Board $69; developer kit ~$149. Good for lighter arm/QDD joints.

name: VESC 6 MkVI
encoder: Sensorless, Hall, ABI, AS5047 SPI encoder support; onboard IMU
notes: Driver/controller (not a motor, so no torque/weight rating). Open-source VESC-based single-axis FOC controller. 3S-12S (11.1V nominal to ~50V charged, 60V abs max spikes), 80A continuous / 120A peak (temperature dependent). Ports: USB, CAN, UAVCAN, 2x UART, SPI, I2C. Price ~USD 255 (GBP 200) single-unit from Trampa. Classic CAN (not CAN-FD).

name: TMC4671 FOC servo controller
encoder: ABN incremental, Hall, analog/digital, SinCos, SPI absolute (external)
notes: Driver/controller IC (not a motor, so no torque/weight rating). Fully integrated hardware-FOC servo controller IC for BLDC/PMSM/stepper/DC (not a turnkey board); paired with a power stage or reference design. Reference designs span voltage/current: TMC4671-TOSV-REF 12-36V up to 6A RMS; TMC4671-LEV-REF up to 55V / ~500W. Control via SPI/UART plus Step/Dir; PWM 25-100 kHz; supports many encoder types. Board/IC price varies by vendor (not listed here).

name: SHA-CG series (SHA-CG Hollow Shaft Actuator)
encoder: magnetic dual absolute, output resolution up to ~20,971,520 pulse/rev
notes: Hollow-shaft AC servo actuator combining a CSG zero-backlash strain-wave gear with a brushless servomotor and integrated servo drive (EtherCAT/CANopen). Four frame sizes, five reduction ratios 50:1 to 160:1. The series delivers up to 3,400 N·m across sizes; positional accuracy better than 1 arcmin and repeatability better than +/-5 arc-sec (recorded as ~0.08 arcmin). This is a multi-size series, so per-size rated/peak torque, weight and speed are not a single value and are left null rather than guessed. 'Zero backlash' recorded as 0 per the manufacturer strain-wave claim. Quote-only pricing.

name: CHA series (Hollow Shaft Servo Actuator)
notes: CHA hollow-shaft servo actuator: synchronous servomotor plus CPU-H series zero-backlash strain-wave gear plus a high-capacity precision output bearing. Available in eight sizes, gear ratios 30:1 to 160:1, with maximum torque from about 9 N·m up to 1,840 N·m across the size range (per Harmonic Drive SE product page). Requires a matching external servo drive (CANopen/EtherCAT drives offered). This is a multi-size series, so per-size rated/peak torque, weight, speed and repeatability are left null rather than guessed. Backlash recorded as 0 per the strain-wave zero-backlash claim. Quote-only pricing.

name: LHS series (Harmonic Drive strain-wave reducer)
notes: Strain-wave (harmonic) gear reducer component, a Harmonic Drive alternative used to build precision robot-arm joints, not a motorized actuator, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. Sizes about 14/17/20/25/32/40/50 with reduction ratios 50/80/100/120/160:1. Rated output torque spans roughly 3.8 N·m (smallest size) up to about 921 N·m (largest size) with allowable peak torque above 4,000 N·m on large sizes, per distributor listings; specific per-size/ratio values are not confirmed from a primary Leaderdrive datasheet, so left null. Marketed as zero-backlash (recorded 0); transmission accuracy / lost motion typically about 10 arc-sec but not confirmed here. Quote-only pricing.

name: LHD series (hollow-shaft harmonic reducer)
notes: Compact hollow-shaft strain-wave (harmonic) gear reducer component for robot-arm joints; no integrated motor, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. Seven sizes (14/17/20/25/32/40 and larger) with reduction ratios 50/80/100/120/160:1; directindustry lists a coaxial hollow-shaft variant in the roughly 100 to 200 N·m class. Per-size rated/peak torque and weight are not confirmed from a primary Leaderdrive datasheet, so left null. Marketed zero-backlash (recorded 0). Quote-only pricing.

name: LCS series (cup-type harmonic reducer)
notes: Cup-type strain-wave (harmonic) gear reducer component used to build precision arm joints; no integrated motor, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. Sizes 8/14/17/20/25/32/40/50 with reduction ratios 50/80/100/120/160:1. Rated output torque spans roughly 3.5 N·m (smallest size) up to about 196 N·m (larger sizes) with allowable peak torque above 2,300 N·m on large sizes, per distributor listings; specific per-size/ratio values are not confirmed from a primary Leaderdrive datasheet, so left null. Marketed zero-backlash (recorded 0). Quote-only pricing.

name: FLEXWAVE WPG series (strain-wave gearhead)
notes: FLEXWAVE strain-wave (harmonic) gearing from Nidec Drive Technology (formerly Nidec-Shimpo). This is a zero-backlash gear unit / gearhead component (flexspline, circular spline, wave generator), not a motorized actuator, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. FLEXWAVE WPG spans five frame sizes (about 35 to 80 mm) with ratios from 50:1 up to 160:1 and maximum torque up to about 346 N·m across the range. Marketed zero-backlash with high repeatability. backdrivable set to false: high-ratio (50:1 to 160:1) strain-wave gearing is effectively non-backdrivable, consistent with the other harmonic units in this file. Per-size rated torque and repeatability-in-arc-sec are not confirmed from a primary datasheet here, so left null. Quote-only pricing.

name: Smart-FLEXWAVE SRH series (smart strain-wave reducer)
notes: Smart-FLEXWAVE (SRH / WPU-SRH-BD) is Nidec Drive Technology's ultra-thin, lightweight zero-backlash strain-wave 'smart reducer' with a built-in sensor that detects output torque and internal temperature, aimed at humanoid and cobot joints. The BD safety variant carries TUV SUD functional-safety certification. It is a reducer-with-sensor module (no integrated motor or drive), so torque/electrical/comms fields are left null pending a primary datasheet with per-size numbers. backdrivable set to false, consistent with high-ratio strain-wave gearing. Zero-backlash recorded as 0. Quote-only pricing.

name: RMD-X10-S2 V3 (1:35)
notes: High-reduction planetary joint (MC-X-500 driver). Peak 100 N.m per RobotShop, rated 50 N.m at 50 rpm, 265 W. Net weight not reliably corroborated: listings vary from ~980 g (Amazon) to ~1190 g (X10 family) to 2.0 kg (gross), so weight and torque density left null. Good for high-torque, low-speed arm joints.

name: MG5010E-i36 V3
notes: LKMTech planetary joint motor with built-in driver and dual encoders (18-bit on motor, 14-bit on reducer). V3 rated/peak torque 13/25 N.m at 36:1, ~74 rpm, 24 V, continuous current ~4.4 A. Some base i36 listings quote 4 N.m. Net weight not published on primary sources.

name: PH54-200-S500-R (Dynamixel-P / Pro+)
notes: Top-end Dynamixel-P (Pro+) joint for humanoids/large arms. Robotis publishes an estimated continuous/rated torque of 44.7 N.m at 24V (29 rpm, 9.3A); no clean peak/stall torque figure is published, so peak and torque_density are left null. Backlash <0.1 deg (~6 arcmin). 200W. RS-485 only.

name: PM54-060-S250-R (Dynamixel-P / Pro+)
notes: Mid-tier 60W Dynamixel-P (Pro+) joint. Robotis lists estimated rated torque 10.1 N.m at 24V (28.3 rpm, 3.0A continuous); no clean peak/stall figure is published, so peak and torque_density are left null. Weight 855 g in the 54x126x54 mm frame (same body as the PH54), confirmed by the Robotis distributor datasheet. Backlash ~6 arcmin. RS-485 only.
